Acoustic Coordinated Reset Neuromodulation (or ACRN) Therapy works by playing tones that dance around your tinnitus frequency. This pattern can help provide you with temporary relief of the ringing caused by tinnitus.

1) Find your frequency by using the slider while playing a tone. Use this to match to your tinnitus frequency.

2) Play the pattern and listen at a low volume. Listen for 5-10 minutes or up to a few hours.

3) Repeat this process daily (or whenever you have ringing symptoms)
